When we remove an interface
column2: we can currently end up having

column1: a pointer to it left in local->scan_sdata after it has been
set down
column2: and then with a hardware scan the scan completion

column1: can try to access it which is a bug. Alternatively
that started as a hardware scan may terminate as though it
was a software scan
column2: if the timing is just right.

column1: On SMP systems
column2: software scan also has a similar problem

column1: just canceling the delayed work and setting a flag isn't
enough since it may be running concurrently; in this case
we would also never restore state of other interfaces.
This patch hopefully fixes the problems by always invoking
ieee80211_scan_completed or requiring it to be invoked by
the driver
column2: I suspect the drivers that have ->hw_scan() are

column1: buggy. The bug will not manifest itself unless you remove
the interface while hw-scanning which will also turn off
the hw
column2: and then add a new interface which will be unusable

column1: until you scan once.
